scenarios.name: make-plan-from-prd
scenarios.rationale: Both responses fail to provide any implementation plan, merely requesting the PRD text.

scenarios.name: plan-with-spike-phase
scenarios.rationale: Response A gives a structured table and phases but lacks the required Phase 0 spike, covers/size/risk/check/verification details, whereas Response B only asks for more information and provides no plan.

scenarios.name: update-plan-after-spike
scenarios.rationale: Response B contains most required sections but omits the Change log and Open questions, whereas Response A provides no relevant plan updates.
